fields.statement: QA at 78a3b478 with a binary built from the branch, in a scratch repo qarepo with an accepted change set serving a milestone. rhiza daemon --once ran against the real Rex server through a proxy rex that passed session ls/new to real rex and only logged window new. With REX_SESSION=session:other and rhiza-qarepo already present: one 'rex session ls --json', no session new, and the run start tab logged as 'rex window new -s rhiza-qarepo ... run start <cs> --permission-mode acceptEdits'. After rex kill rhiza-qarepo and with REX_SESSION unset: 'rex session new rhiza-qarepo -c <root> --json' ran once, the real server listed rhiza-qarepo afterwards, and the run tab again carried -s rhiza-qarepo. rhiza daemon start (tab mode) also created rhiza-qarepo on the real server and reused it on later starts. When the proxy failed on session ls, the daemon reported the error and opened no tab.

QA at 78a3b478 with a binary built from the branch on macOS, in a scratch repo qarepo with HOME pointed at a scratch dir. With no systemctl on PATH, daemon install and daemon uninstall each exited 2 with 'needs systemd: systemctl is not on PATH' and wrote nothing. With logging fake systemctl and loginctl on PATH, install wrote ~/.config/systemd/user/rhiza-qarepo.service (marker comment, After=rex.service, WorkingDirectory the main checkout, ExecStart=<binary> daemon, Restart=always, WantedBy=default.target) and called systemctl --user daemon-reload, systemctl --user enable --now rhiza-qarepo.service and loginctl enable-linger. A second install said nothing changed and left the file as it was, with no daemon-reload (it repeated enable --now and enable-linger, which are idempotent). From a linked worktree, daemon status said mode service. Uninstall called systemctl --user disable --now and daemon-reload, removed the file, and status went back to mode tab.

QA at 78a3b478 with a binary built from the branch, in scratch repo qarepo on the real Rex server. Tab mode: daemon status said 'Mode: tab'. daemon start --json returned {changed:true, mode:tab}, opened the Rex tab 'rhiza daemon' in session rhiza-qarepo, and status then said 'Daemon running'. A second start said 'The daemon already runs' and opened no tab. daemon stop said 'Asked the daemon to stop'; the process exited and status said not running. A further stop said 'No daemon runs'. Service mode, after daemon install with fake systemctl/loginctl and a scratch HOME: status said 'Mode: service', and start and stop logged exactly 'systemctl --user start rhiza-qarepo.service' and 'systemctl --user stop rhiza-qarepo.service'. After uninstall the mode was tab again. On a fresh repo with no permission mode set, start reported success, but the tab's daemon --autonomous exited at once ('needs --permission-mode'). See the minor finding.

QA at 78a3b478: rhiza tui app autonomy --once in scratch repo qarepo printed the settings JSON (key, value, source, default). The interactive app ran in a real Rex tab and was driven with rex send-key. It showed 'Daemon not running', every daemon and autonomy setting with value and source, and the footer 'd start/stop daemon'. d then y started the daemon in the Rex tab 'rhiza daemon', and after r it showed 'Daemon running, process Mac.localdomain:47359'. d asked 'Stop the daemon Mac.localdomain:47359? y/n', y ended that process, and the app showed 'Daemon not running'. With the cursor on rhiza.autonomy.plan, enter toggled it from owner to auto, and git config rhiza.autonomy.plan then read auto.
